rules: A price is never taken from a model's memory. It is read from the provider's published pricing and recorded with its source and check timestamp.
Every entry carries a `confidence`. `verified` means this build read the provider's own pricing page. `secondary` means it came from a cached table or third party and has NOT been confirmed.
A `secondary` price may produce an estimate, and the estimate must say it rests on an unverified price (REQ-COST-03).
Token counts are measured and never estimated. Money is derived. The cost table never presents one as the other.

egressNote: Vendor pricing pages were unreachable through this environment's egress proxy when this file was written, so nothing is marked `verified`. Do not upgrade a confidence level without a successful fetch.
